items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Miss Ann Price who is the choir director of the New City Methodist Church is going to accompany me with the music

ctx.x: Yes, everybody seemed to know me and the Master of Ceremonies at the dances-they'd always introduce me and I'd go up and say a few words and sing one of my Pima chants, and it's beautiful to be recognized. It's nice, good feeling. And you try to reciprocate by performing. Even now, around my neighborhood here in Rockland County I do things for senior citizens. I do benefits just to keep in trim and my chops in line right here and I'm semi-retired, but I still love to go out and play now. Next Wednesday I will be…
